_comment_appVersion: x-app-version header. factory_loop.js auto-bumps this when the server returns OUTDATED_VERSION, so the value here only needs to be a recent one.
_comment_factories: Your own building IDs, grouped by production tier. Grab them from DevTools (see README). Counts are read from these arrays — add an ID and the bot starts driving it, no code change.
_comment_areas: Area IDs that CLAIM_AREA harvests. There is no steel area — steel claims the copper one.
_comment_durations: Production time per tier, in seconds. MUST match your boost state: use these halved values only while boost.vip is true, otherwise copy durationsNoVip over this.
_comment_boost: vip=true means the account owns the skip-ads pack, so the x2 buttons cost only a click and the bot presses them for you. vip=false disables both boost systems — set durations to durationsNoVip as well.
_comment_durationsNoVip: Un-boosted durations (double the boosted ones). Copy over durations when boost.vip is false.
_comment_telegram: Optional. Leave both empty to disable alerts; the bot runs unchanged.
